supersedes: arc-relay-tapline-opening-cohort-v7 (one distributed-wells cell failed formation-freeze because exact Well claims treated an already-departed outstanding Core as still present; v4 continuously patrols each Well and reserves exact collection for visible or remembered loose Cores)
purpose: Final all-eligible comparison of four coherent Tapline opening strategies with rules, map, mind, composition, seeds, and side assignments controlled.
candidatePreparation: Direct Mid v3 and Distributed Wells v4 each passed their exact prior failure seed plus a standard six-cell exhibit. Pincer v3 and Split v2 are unchanged. The executor now rejects an inherited first action that is unavailable on the current tick. Seeds 9801-9812 are fresh.

entrants.label: Direct Mid
entrants.intent: Stay together, win the shortest centre Core race, then maintain moving pressure around whichever known Core can be converted through the shortest path.

entrants.label: Four-plus-four Pincer
entrants.intent: Send two self-sufficient four-body wings through the full outer corridors, contest the enemy Well from both sides, and convert any Core either wing wins.

entrants.label: Split Interception
entrants.intent: Watch both outer corridors with paired interceptors, screen centre, and keep a home logistics pair active around the own Well.

entrants.label: Distributed Wells
entrants.intent: Field a continuous 3-3-2 economy across all Wells and release at most one local worker per remembered loose Core.

evaluation.design: twelve fresh seed blocks, every unordered pair, both side assignments
evaluation.outcomesAre: a deterministic design screen over these registered seeds, not a human-fun or population claim
evaluation.leverPolicy: A cross-matchup dominance or dominated alarm authorizes one minimal one-factor probe. Test a geometry-only flank timing adjustment first; change Core supply or cadence only if geometry cannot isolate the mechanism. Never rewrite a candidate inside the comparison.
